progress.command:
git add -A && cat > /tmp/msg <<'EOF'
feat: load skills (SKILL.md), list them in the system prompt, and expand /skill:<name>

Discover skills in packages (extensions, and the new skills input), the
project's .pi/skills and .agents/skills (trust_project only), and
<agent_dir>/skills. A built-in pi-durable extension, pi-action, lists them
in an available_skills section, after pi-action-context's project_context
section, and /skill:<name> puts a skill's SKILL.md in the request; an
unknown name gets an error reply.

Closes #54
EOF
GIT_EDITOR=true git -c core.editor=true rebase --continue 2>&1 | tail -3; git commit --amend -F /tmp/msg 2>&1 | tail -2; npx commitlint --from origin/main --to HEAD 2>&1 | tail -5; git log --oneline -3; git status --short | head
